objective: Signing up no longer requires an emailed code: a new account can sign in straight away and verifies later from Account settings, with the consequences for password reset stated honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: USERS-006 is live in production, and the brief's dev-pool proof is recorded in the PR body with its date. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

infra/lib/auth-stack.ts adds a pre sign-up trigger on the user pool: an inline function in the auth stack, not the shared backend image and not in the VPC, that sets autoConfirmUser true and leaves autoVerifyEmail false, so a new account is confirmed with email_verified false and no code is sent at sign-up.

The trigger's role has no permission beyond writing its own logs, carries the permissions boundary, and iam-policy.test.ts and permissions-boundary.test.ts pass unchanged. Its runtime is pinned, and its timeout is 5 seconds or less. auth-stack.test.ts pins the trigger, the runtime and that the code does not set autoVerifyEmail.
autoVerify stays { email: true }, so a code can still be requested for verification, and keepOriginal stays. deletionProtection stays. No pool replacement appears in the synthesised change.

SignUpPage needs no new step: userConfirmed true already goes to sign-in, and the test that pins this stays. Its copy no longer mentions a code. The page tells the user they can sign in now and verify later.
ConfirmPage and SignInPage keep handling an unconfirmed account, so anyone mid-flow when this ships is not stranded. Their existing tests pass unchanged.
ForgotPasswordPage says, before the code step, that a reset code is only sent to a verified address, and Account settings' unverified state says that verifying is what makes password reset possible.

Notification email is never sent to an address that is not verified: app.notifications.email treats email_verified not true on the AdminGetUser answer as a skip, logged without the address. A test pins it.
An existing confirmed account is unaffected and still signs in. Nothing is migrated.

Browser rows on localhost against the dev pool, reported with evidence or NOT DONE: sign up with a new human-provided test address, then sign in with no code; create the profile; Account settings shows the unverified state; the emailed verification code works and the state turns green; forgot password on an unverified account shows the honest copy.
frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/USERS-007.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x01-users.md and 0x08-frontend.md record the new sign-up rule and its reset limit.
